title: Rav Chama bar Ada, Emissary of Zion
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Beitzah 25b Rav Nachman said to him: “When you go up there, go around by the Ladder of Tyre and go to Rabbi Yaakov bar Idi.” While he was on his way, Rabbi Yaakov bar Idi died; when he went up, he found Rabbi Zerika, etc. (Rashi explains that he regularly went up to Jerusalem, and therefore he was called Emissary of Zion.)
